ModMetaData.name: Workbench Groups
ModMetaData.author: Joof
ModMetaData.description:
Link work stations together so they share one bill list, and choose how those bills are worked through.
## Linking
Select two or more work stations and press "Link work orders". They now share a single list of bills, so any pawn can carry out any order at whichever station is free. Stations can only be linked if they make the same things — an electric and a fueled stove link fine; a stove and a tailoring bench do not.
Linking mirrors the vanilla storage-group interaction, so there is nothing new to learn.
## Ordering modes
- **In order** (default) — vanilla behaviour. The list is worked top-down. - **Round robin** — one item from each bill in turn, wrapping around. Bills visibly rotate as they are worked, so the top of the list is always what happens next.
## No more overshooting
Because a group's stations share their bills, several pawns could otherwise start the same "make 5" order at once and produce far more than asked. This mod reserves the count when a pawn starts work rather than when they finish, so a group makes exactly what you asked for.
Q. Can I add this to an existing save? A. Yes. Nothing changes until you link something.
Q. Can I remove it from an existing save? A. Yes. Every station keeps a valid bill list — the group's bills stay on the station you linked from, and the others get back whatever they had before linking. No errors.
Q. Does it work with modded workbenches? A. Yes, as long as they are ordinary work tables. Mech gestators, subcores and other self-running benches are deliberately excluded because their bills are tied to their own building.
Q. Known limitations? A. A group shares vanilla's cap of 15 bills, rather than 15 per station. Unfinished items (anything crafted over multiple sessions, like some modded recipes) cannot be shared and are refused at link time.
Q. Was AI used? A. Yes — this mod was written with Claude, reviewed and tested by a human.
